Description:
BO7 movement for Black Ops III ZOMBIES/MULTIPLAYER/FREERUN. Includes: Omnimovement, wall jump and corner slicing. Future update to include dolphin diving - RIP OPEN MATCHMAKING & CARRY FORWARD IN BO7!!!! ACTIVISION SCREWED US OVER!!

Steam Players - load right in after subscribing :) 

Wall Jump Controls: 

[F1] Front + side jumping enabled [*Default] 
[F2] Side only jumping 
[F3] Front only jumping 
[F4] Toggle between auto / double-tap jump 
[F5] Player Wall Jumping Disabled

*Auto front + side jumping is enabled at first load in - saves most recent setting upon exit

Console commands for auto jump settings:

set bo7_mywallspace 0 | enable auto jump
set bo7_mywallspace 1 | [Double-tap Jump] required - tap jump twice quickly in the air to wall jump
set bo7_wjtog 1 | toggle auto on/off
bo7_wjstatus | shows whether your setting has reached the server (OK - ...)



**BOIII client** Follow the additional step below to enable the mod:

1. Find bo7_boiii.dll in the mod's download folder:
   - If BOIII downloaded the mod: Black Ops III\mods\3808733329
   - If you subscribed via Steam: steamapps\workshop\content\311210\3808733329 in your Steam library
2. Copy it into Black Ops III\boiii\plugins. Make the plugins folder if it isn't there.
3. Start BOIII with -unsafe-lua, or click Yes when BOIII asks about unsafe Lua - this is required as omnimovement and corner slicing are DLL based



Comment with any suggestions/bugs that you may have - enjoy!
